AND V.memNum = #{memNum}
AND V.startDate >= TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND V.endDate < TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1
AND V.endDate >= TRUNC(SYSDATE)
AND V.endDate < TRUNC(SYSDATE)
ORDER BY V.memberName ASC, V.voucherId ASC ) k WHERE ROWNUM <= #{endRow} ) WHERE rn > #{offset} ) pg JOIN voucher_log V ON V.voucherId = pg.voucherId ORDER BY pg.rn
